newsitem.title: USA: Individual settles issues with founder.
newsitem.headline: Individual settles issues with founder.

text.p: Individual Inc said on Monday that it has reached an agreement with Yosi Amram, founder and former chief executive officer, over the issues arising from his "separation" from the company in the summer.

Amram will continue to serve on the company's board. Amram resigned in August after a leave of absence. The company formed an office of the president and began a search for a new chief executive while Amram was on leave.
The company had named Michael Kolowich, the former president of AT&T Corp's new media services unit, president and chief executive officer in early September.
